items.summary: Read bounded facts about the active After Effects project.
items.sideEffectSummary: Reads project state without modifying it.

items.summary: Read the open After Effects project's bit depth.
items.sideEffectSummary: Reads project bit depth without changing After Effects state.
preconditions: An After Effects project must be open.

items.summary: Set the open After Effects project's bit depth.
items.sideEffectSummary: Changes project bit depth and creates one After Effects Undo step.
preconditions: An After Effects project must be open.
targetDepth must differ from the current project bit depth.

items.summary: List a bounded page of items in the open After Effects project.
items.sideEffectSummary: Reads project items without changing After Effects state.
preconditions: An After Effects project must be open.

items.summary: List a bounded page of layers in one After Effects composition.
items.sideEffectSummary: Reads composition layers without changing After Effects state.
preconditions: An After Effects project must be open.
compositionLocator must come from ae.project.items.list@1.

items.summary: List a bounded page of selected layers in one After Effects composition.
items.sideEffectSummary: Reads selected composition layers without changing After Effects state.
preconditions: An After Effects project must be open.
compositionLocator must come from ae.project.items.list@1.

items.summary: Read the current time of one After Effects composition.
items.sideEffectSummary: Reads composition time without changing After Effects state.
preconditions: An After Effects project must be open.
compositionLocator must come from ae.project.items.list@1.

items.summary: Set the current time of one After Effects composition.
items.sideEffectSummary: Changes composition current time and creates one After Effects Undo step.
preconditions: An After Effects project must be open.
compositionLocator must come from ae.project.items.list@1.
targetTime must differ from the composition's current time.

items.summary: Create one root composition in After Effects.
items.sideEffectSummary: Creates one root composition and one After Effects Undo step.
preconditions: An After Effects project must be open.

items.summary: Create one null or solid layer in an After Effects composition.
items.sideEffectSummary: Creates one composition layer, may create one solid project item, and creates one After Effects Undo step.
preconditions: An After Effects project must be open.
compositionLocator must come from ae.project.items.list@1.
kind must be null or solid and solid-only options require kind solid.

items.summary: Apply one installed After Effects effect to a layer by exact match name.
items.sideEffectSummary: Adds one installed effect to one layer and creates one After Effects Undo step.
preconditions: An After Effects project must be open.
layerLocator must come from ae.composition.layers.list@1.
effectMatchName must exactly identify one installed effect.

items.summary: List a bounded page of direct properties on an After Effects layer or property group.
items.sideEffectSummary: Reads layer properties and safe primitive values without changing After Effects state.
preconditions: An After Effects project must be open.
layerLocator must come from ae.composition.layers.list@1.
parentPropertyLocator must come from ae.layer.properties.list@1 for the same layer.

items.summary: List a bounded page of exact keyframes on one After Effects layer property.
items.sideEffectSummary: Reads native keyframe times, primitive values, and interpolation without changing After Effects state.
preconditions: An After Effects project must be open.
propertyLocator must come from ae.layer.properties.list@1 in the current native session.
The property must be a keyframeable primitive scalar, vector, or color leaf stream.

items.summary: Set one non-keyframed primitive After Effects layer property value.
items.sideEffectSummary: Changes one primitive layer property and creates one After Effects Undo step.
preconditions: An After Effects project must be open.
Both locators must come from ae.layer.properties.list@1 for the same layer.
The property must be a non-keyframed scalar, vector, or color leaf stream.
value must differ from the property's current sampled value.

items.summary: Read current After Effects project context and selected items.
items.sideEffectSummary: Reads project context without changing After Effects state.
preconditions: An After Effects project must be open.

items.summary: Read metadata and bounded type facts for one After Effects project item.
items.sideEffectSummary: Reads project item metadata without changing After Effects state.
preconditions: An After Effects project must be open.
itemLocator must come from ae.project.context.read@1 or ae.project.items.list@1.

items.summary: Read exact settings for one After Effects composition.
items.sideEffectSummary: Reads composition settings without changing After Effects state.
preconditions: An After Effects project must be open.
compositionLocator must come from ae.project.context.read@1 or ae.project.items.list@1.

items.summary: Set the exact work area of one After Effects composition.
items.sideEffectSummary: Changes one composition work area and creates one After Effects Undo step.
preconditions: An After Effects project must be open.
compositionLocator must come from ae.project.context.read@1 or ae.project.items.list@1.
start plus duration must fit within the composition duration.
The requested work area must differ from the current work area.

items.summary: Rename one After Effects project item.
items.sideEffectSummary: Changes one project item name and creates one After Effects Undo step.
preconditions: An After Effects project must be open.
itemLocator must come from ae.project.context.read@1 or ae.project.items.list@1.
name must differ from the current project item name.

items.summary: Set or clear one After Effects project item comment.
items.sideEffectSummary: Changes one project item comment and creates one After Effects Undo step.
preconditions: An After Effects project must be open.
itemLocator must come from ae.project.context.read@1 or ae.project.items.list@1.
comment must differ from the current project item comment.

items.summary: Set one numeric After Effects project item label slot.
items.sideEffectSummary: Changes one project item label and creates one After Effects Undo step.
preconditions: An After Effects project must be open.
itemLocator must come from ae.project.context.read@1 or ae.project.items.list@1.
labelId must differ from the current project item label.

items.summary: Duplicate one After Effects composition with an explicit new name.
items.sideEffectSummary: Adds one composition and creates one After Effects Undo step.
preconditions: An After Effects project must be open.
compositionLocator must come from ae.project.context.read@1 or ae.project.items.list@1.

items.summary: Read one After Effects layer and its exact timeline state.
items.sideEffectSummary: Reads layer state without changing After Effects state.
preconditions: An After Effects project must be open.
layerLocator must come from a current native layer listing.

items.summary: Rename one After Effects layer.
items.sideEffectSummary: Changes one layer name and creates one After Effects Undo step.
preconditions: layerLocator must be current.
name must differ from the current name.

items.summary: Set one layer in point and duration using exact rational time.
items.sideEffectSummary: Changes one layer range and creates one After Effects Undo step.
preconditions: layerLocator must be current.
The range must fit the composition and differ from the current range.

items.summary: Set one layer start time using exact rational time.
items.sideEffectSummary: Changes one layer start time and creates one After Effects Undo step.
preconditions: layerLocator must be current.
startTime must differ from the current start time.

items.summary: Set one layer stretch as an exact signed ratio.
items.sideEffectSummary: Changes one layer stretch and creates one After Effects Undo step.
preconditions: layerLocator must be current.
stretch must be nonzero and differ from the current stretch.

items.summary: Move one layer to an explicit composition stack index.
items.sideEffectSummary: Changes one layer stack position and creates one After Effects Undo step.
preconditions: layerLocator must be current.
targetStackIndex must exist and differ from the current stack index.

items.summary: Set or clear one layer parent.
items.sideEffectSummary: Changes one layer parent and creates one After Effects Undo step.
preconditions: Both locators must be current and in the same composition.
A layer cannot parent itself and the requested parent must differ from the current parent.

items.summary: Duplicate one layer with an explicit new name.
items.sideEffectSummary: Adds one layer and creates one After Effects Undo step.
preconditions: layerLocator must be current.

items.summary: Read one layer's current project-item source.
items.sideEffectSummary: Reads layer source state without changing After Effects state.
preconditions: layerLocator must identify a current native layer.

items.summary: Read one layer's modern Track Matte relationship.
items.sideEffectSummary: Reads Track Matte state without changing After Effects state.
preconditions: layerLocator must identify a current native layer.

items.summary: Set one arbitrary same-composition Track Matte.
items.sideEffectSummary: Changes one Track Matte relationship and creates one After Effects Undo step.
preconditions: layerLocator must identify a current native layer.
matteLayerLocator must identify a distinct current layer in the same composition.

items.summary: Clear one layer's Track Matte while preserving its stored mode.
items.sideEffectSummary: Removes one Track Matte relationship and creates one After Effects Undo step.
preconditions: layerLocator must identify a current native layer.
The layer must have an active Track Matte relationship.

items.summary: Read source media capabilities and layer AV switches.
items.sideEffectSummary: Reads AV state without changing After Effects state.
preconditions: layerLocator must identify a current native layer.

items.summary: Set one layer's audio-enabled switch.
items.sideEffectSummary: Changes one layer audio switch and creates one After Effects Undo step.
preconditions: layerLocator must identify a current native layer.
The current source must have audio and the requested value must differ.

items.summary: Set one layer's video-enabled switch.
items.sideEffectSummary: Changes one layer video switch and creates one After Effects Undo step.
preconditions: layerLocator must identify a current native layer.
The current source must have video and the requested value must differ.

items.summary: Read one layer's render switches, quality, and compositing mode.
items.sideEffectSummary: Reads layer state without changing After Effects state.
preconditions: layerLocator must identify a current native layer.

items.summary: Set one allowlisted layer switch.
items.sideEffectSummary: Changes one layer switch and creates one After Effects Undo step.
preconditions: layerLocator must identify a current native layer.
The requested value must differ from current state.

items.summary: Set one layer's rendering quality.
items.sideEffectSummary: Changes layer quality and creates one After Effects Undo step.
preconditions: layerLocator must identify a current native layer.
The requested quality must differ from current state.

items.summary: Set one layer's allowlisted blending mode while preserving matte and alpha flags.
items.sideEffectSummary: Changes layer blending mode and creates one After Effects Undo step.
preconditions: layerLocator must identify a current native layer.
The requested mode must differ from current state.

items.summary: Read one After Effects property keyframe by exact composition time.
items.sideEffectSummary: Reads one native keyframe without changing After Effects state.
preconditions: An After Effects project must be open.
propertyLocator must identify a keyframed primitive leaf stream.
A keyframe must exist at the exact requested composition time.

items.summary: Add one After Effects property keyframe at exact composition time.
items.sideEffectSummary: Adds one native keyframe and creates one After Effects Undo step.
preconditions: Both locators must be current and identify one keyframeable primitive leaf stream.
No keyframe may exist at the exact requested composition time.
value must match the property value type.

items.summary: Set one After Effects property keyframe value.
items.sideEffectSummary: Changes one native keyframe value and creates one After Effects Undo step.
preconditions: Both locators must be current and identify one keyframed primitive leaf stream.
A keyframe must exist at the exact requested composition time.
value must match the property value type and differ from the current value.

items.summary: Set incoming and outgoing interpolation for one After Effects property keyframe.
items.sideEffectSummary: Changes one native keyframe interpolation and creates one After Effects Undo step.
preconditions: Both locators must be current and identify one keyframed primitive leaf stream.
A keyframe must exist at the exact requested composition time.
The requested interpolation pair must differ from the current pair.

items.summary: Set typed temporal ease dimensions for one After Effects property keyframe.
items.sideEffectSummary: Changes one native keyframe temporal ease and creates one After Effects Undo step.
preconditions: Both locators must be current and identify one keyframed primitive leaf stream.
A keyframe must exist at the exact requested composition time.
dimensions must cover the property's temporal dimensions in zero-based order and differ from current ease.

items.summary: Set one behavior flag on an After Effects property keyframe.
items.sideEffectSummary: Changes one native keyframe behavior and creates one After Effects Undo step.
preconditions: Both locators must be current and identify one keyframed primitive leaf stream.
A keyframe must exist at the exact requested composition time.
The requested behavior state must be supported and differ from current state.

items.summary: Delete one After Effects property keyframe at exact composition time.
items.sideEffectSummary: Deletes one native keyframe and creates one After Effects Undo step.
preconditions: Both locators must be current and identify one keyframed primitive leaf stream.
A keyframe must exist at the exact requested composition time.
An After Effects project must be open.
The operation-specific locators must belong to the current native session.
items.sideEffectSummary: Reads bounded After Effects effect, mask, or footage state without changing it.
items.summary: Execute one closed native effect, mask, or footage read.

preconditions: An After Effects project must be open.
The operation-specific locators must belong to the current native session.
items.sideEffectSummary: Changes one bounded After Effects media-editing target and creates one Undo step.
items.summary: Execute one closed native effect, mask, or footage mutation.
Execute frozen ae.shape.layer.create operation.
items.sideEffectSummary: Changes bounded After Effects authored state and creates one Undo step.
preconditions: An After Effects project must be open.

items.summary: Execute frozen ae.shape.groups.list operation.
items.sideEffectSummary: Reads bounded After Effects authored state without changing it.
preconditions: An After Effects project must be open.

items.summary: Execute frozen ae.shape.group.create operation.
items.sideEffectSummary: Changes bounded After Effects authored state and creates one Undo step.
preconditions: An After Effects project must be open.

items.summary: Execute frozen ae.shape.path.set operation.
items.sideEffectSummary: Changes bounded After Effects authored state and creates one Undo step.
preconditions: An After Effects project must be open.

items.summary: Execute frozen ae.shape.fill-style.set operation.
items.sideEffectSummary: Changes bounded After Effects authored state and creates one Undo step.
preconditions: An After Effects project must be open.

items.summary: Execute frozen ae.shape.stroke-style.set operation.
items.sideEffectSummary: Changes bounded After Effects authored state and creates one Undo step.
preconditions: An After Effects project must be open.

items.summary: Execute frozen ae.shape.group.reorder operation.
items.sideEffectSummary: Changes bounded After Effects authored state and creates one Undo step.
preconditions: An After Effects project must be open.

items.summary: Execute frozen ae.marker.list operation.
items.sideEffectSummary: Reads bounded After Effects authored state without changing it.
preconditions: An After Effects project must be open.

items.summary: Execute frozen ae.marker.create operation.
items.sideEffectSummary: Changes bounded After Effects authored state and creates one Undo step.
preconditions: An After Effects project must be open.

items.summary: Execute frozen ae.marker.set operation.
items.sideEffectSummary: Changes bounded After Effects authored state and creates one Undo step.
preconditions: An After Effects project must be open.

items.summary: Execute frozen ae.marker.delete operation.
items.sideEffectSummary: Changes bounded After Effects authored state and creates one Undo step.
preconditions: An After Effects project must be open.

items.summary: Set exact dimensions for one After Effects composition.
items.sideEffectSummary: Changes composition dimensions and creates one After Effects Undo step.
preconditions: compositionLocator must be current.
width and height must differ from the current dimensions.

items.summary: Set the exact duration of one After Effects composition.
items.sideEffectSummary: Changes composition duration and creates one After Effects Undo step.
preconditions: compositionLocator must be current.
duration must be frame-aligned and contain the work area.

items.summary: Set the exact frame rate of one After Effects composition.
items.sideEffectSummary: Changes composition frame rate and creates one After Effects Undo step.
preconditions: compositionLocator must be current.
frameRate must satisfy the pinned normalization policy.

items.summary: Set the exact pixel aspect ratio of one After Effects composition.
items.sideEffectSummary: Changes composition pixel aspect ratio and creates one After Effects Undo step.
preconditions: compositionLocator must be current.
pixelAspectRatio must differ from the current ratio.

items.summary: Set the exact RGBA8 background colour of one After Effects composition.
items.sideEffectSummary: Changes composition background colour and creates one After Effects Undo step.
preconditions: compositionLocator must be current.
backgroundColor must differ from the current colour.

items.summary: Set the exact display start time of one After Effects composition.
items.sideEffectSummary: Changes composition display start time without creating an After Effects Undo step.
preconditions: compositionLocator must be current.
displayStartTime must be frame-aligned and differ from the current time.
